text: Ophthalmology is a discipline in clinical medicine that studies the anatomy, physiology, pathology and disease prevention and treatment of visual organs (eyeballs, ocular appendages and related nervous systems). The course aims to enable students to master the knowledge of diagnosis, treatment and prevention of eye diseases, cultivate clinical thinking and operational skills in ophthalmology, and ultimately achieve precise diagnosis and treatment of eye diseases (such as myopia, cataract, glaucoma, retinal diseases, etc.).
